svg.title: Historical Well and Reinjection Counts
svg.desc: Source: Hebei plains, June 2015, 1,120 wells including 720 Guantao porous-reservoir wells and 35 reinjection wells. Shandong: >800 Guantao/Dongying porous-reservoir wells, 40 reinjection wells. Tianjin: 260 Minghuazhen/Guantao wells, 60 reinjection wells. Xianyang: 100 Zhangjiapo/Bahe/Gaoling-unit wells, 8 reinjection wells. Historical source figures, not current inventories.
